High Points:


Feeling of purpose and strength while preparing for 
darshan.

Emotional satisfaction knowing she’s maintaining 
tradition.

Quiet morning atmosphere adds to her peace of mind.

Sense of belonging to a larger spiritual community.

Occasional body aches or 
dizziness before leaving.

Hesitation if family members are 
busy and can’t accompany her.

construction at temple.

Anxiety over managing stairs or 
uneven flooring alone.
